text:
deploy-bot: Deploy window open 18:00 UTC. Initiating rampwave for feature `experimental-model-routing`.
Details: staged percentages 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~40m, canary version pinned to v2.3.1 for first two steps. Rollout ID r-4725-03-20-01.

claire: Quick confirm — are we pinning traffic for cohorts to `v2.3.1` up through 25%? Need to avoid inadvertent model switchover.

joe: Yes pin to v2.3.1 for cohorts <=25%. I'll be on-call to execute rollback if telemetry crosses thresholds. Will set manual holdpoints at each step.

maya: Telemetry gating: alert if request_error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR latency p99 > 1200ms. Also run the regression-smoke eval every 5m for the canary prompt set. I added a watch in dashboards.

claire: ack. Patching rollout policy now. snippet for ops: 
```
"rollout": [
  { "pct": 1, "duration": "10m", "version": "v2.3.1" },
  { "pct": 5, "duration": "10m", "version": "v2.3.1" },
  { "pct": 25, "duration": "15m", "version": "v2.3.1" },
  { "pct": 100, "duration": "5m", "version": "v2.3.1" }
]
```

lena: If we need to rollback: immediate halt -> set toggle 0% and rollback traffic to v2.2.9 pinned buckets. Joe, can you own the rollback runbook execution?

joe: I'll own it. Rollback command ready: `rdctl toggle set experimental-model-routing 0 --reason "auto-rollback"`. Also plan to revert canary routing rule to pinned-v2.2.9 buckets.

ops-bot: Canary metrics stream: p50 220ms, p95 430ms, p99 980ms, error_rate 0.3% :thumbsup: (no host anomalies).

deploy-bot: Stepping to 1% now. Will post each step status here.

claire: Watching graphs. If host gpu-7 memory usage spikes > 85% call for halt.

maya: Started eval run (regression-smoke). Posting quick diff snapshot in 4m.

ops-bot: Canary at 1% success. No anomalies. Next scheduled step in 10m; holding for manual ok before 25%.

joe: Reminder: do NOT auto-increase above 25% without explicit thumbs-up in this thread from eng-releases.

claire: Agreed. I'll post release note draft after we hit 100% and validate evals :white_check_mark:.

lena: Documenting rollback steps in the incident runbook and tagging postmortem template in case we see regression.

deploy-bot: Noted. Rolling schedule logged. End of thread updates will include timestamps and final release note link.
